procedures.title: Trait and inheritance source regression
steps: Run DevTools/Verify-TraitCatalog.ps1, DevTools/Verify-ColorInheritance.ps1 and DevTools/Verify-CrossPollination.ps1 from the exact candidate using Windows PowerShell -NoProfile -File.
Record individual exit codes; these are source checks, not in-game evidence.

procedures.title: Plant and produce visual source regression
steps: Run DevTools/Verify-AutoPlantMasks.ps1, DevTools/Verify-MaskPainterTools.ps1, DevTools/Verify-ColorTraitUI.ps1 and DevTools/Verify-RandomVarietyGrid.ps1 against the candidate.
Require every selected script to exit 0. These checks do not establish GPU or visual fidelity.

procedures.title: Integration and definition safety regression
steps: Run DevTools/Verify-EventRouting.ps1, DevTools/Verify-ImmutablePlantDefs.ps1, DevTools/Verify-PlayerFactionSafety.ps1 and DevTools/Verify-KnowledgeMigration.ps1 against the candidate.
The older Knowledge Cultivar UI and Insight Canvas checks require external dependency layout; qualify separately with matching dependency sources.

procedures.title: RimTest toolchain preflight
steps: Run rimtest doctor --json from the candidate checkout using the supported installed RimLiaison launcher.
A blocked or missing promoted toolchain is a blocker, not a pass. Do not substitute a manual game launch or DLL copy.

procedures.title: RimTest affected gameplay validation
steps: After a successful doctor, run rimtest affected --run --json from the exact candidate; use the smoke suite in TestCatalog/rimtest.catalog.json as the documented fallback.
Require artifact freshness and record build, runtime, test and cleanup results. Do not count static scripts as gameplay passes.

procedures.title: Future Waylith rendering acceptance
steps: After an actual 1.7 implementation, validate the exact 1.7 candidate and dependencies through RimTest; this procedure is not evidence that 1.7 is supported.
Inspect vanilla and modded plants, wind, growth stages, masks, produce, lighting, snow, shadows and UI preview. Compare render cost and memory on representative fields.
Record screenshots, shader compile status, candidate identity and profiler evidence; preserve normal vanilla fallback.
